messages:
Sam K: Hey folks — I filed my resignation this morning. My last day will be 2026-05-15. Can someone confirm the offboarding checklist? Main concerns: when benefits actually end / when COBRA info arrives, and laptop return logistics (I’m remote).

Alyssa (People Ops): Sorry to hear you’re leaving, Sam. Quick answers: benefits remain active through your last day (05/15/2026). COBRA packet is sent by the payroll vendor within ~14 business days after termination; you have 60 days to elect. I’ll DM the vendor contact and the exit survey link: http://go.redwood/exit-survey

Jordan (IT): Noted. For laptop return we can either email a prepaid return label or schedule a carrier pickup from your address. If you want a label, confirm shipping address + serial number. For pickup, give a preferred date. We’ll also schedule account deprovisioning the morning after your last day unless you request otherwise.

Sam K: Shipping address: 123 Maple Ave, Apt 4, Oakland CA 94607. Laptop serial: SML-ABC12345. Label preferred. Also please keep Okta/SSO access until last day so I can finish handoffs.

Mike (Security): Re deprovisioning: plan is to remove SSO (Okta) entitlements, Slack, GitHub, Jira, AWS console, Confluence, Databricks. Target removal window is the day after last day (05/16/2026) morning. If there are long-lived service credentials that need rotation, note them here or create a ticket.

Priya (Benefits): Quick COBRA detail: the packet comes from ADP, and if you elect, coverage is retroactive to your loss-of-coverage date (05/16/2026). You have 60 days from the date of the packet to elect; premiums are retroactive to that coverage date. If you want an estimate of monthly premium, DM me and I’ll pull the specific numbers for your plan.

Alyssa (People Ops): Exit interview — we usually do a 30-min Zoom the week after your last day. Preference? We can also accept a written form. I’ll also confirm final paycheck timing (normally the next regular payroll cycle) and any PTO payout rules for CA.

Sam K: Zoom works. Prefer Wed 05/20 morning. I’ll fill out the exit survey now. One more question: any steps I need to take for 401(k) rollover?

Priya (Benefits): 401(k) vendor is Fidelity. Employer match stops after final payroll. You can initiate a rollover directly with Fidelity — I’ll DM the rep and send the documentation.

Jordan (IT): Label request submitted. UPS will email a return label and pickup options. Please wipe personal files prior to shipping and sign the asset return form: https://redwood.intranet/it/asset-return

People Ops Bot: Reminder sent: Complete Exit Survey, Asset Return form, and Confidentiality Reminder. Links emailed to Sam K.

Sam K: Thanks all. If anything changes on timing I’ll update here. Appreciate the help. :thumbsup:
